title: Harden seal checking in `check-seal`, `check-design-patterns` and `check-prds` (`ia-design-base` / `ia-product-base` 0.1.2, `@inventarch/public-kits` 1.2.2)
summary: Moves `ia-approval` to 0.1.1, `ia-design-base` and `ia-product-base` to 0.1.2, and `@inventarch/public-kits` to 1.2.2. All three verifiers accept a `current-revision` seal on a revision computed with `@approval` records stripped only when every other record keeps its digest and none is added, and only approval-system's `@approval` counts as an approval there, so stripping approvals can never stand in for a change to another record. `check-design-patterns` and `check-prds` also fail a `current-revision` seal when no revision could be computed, and report an `@approval` saved under a file name other than its record, digest and key as `APPROVAL_FILE_MISNAMED`, as `check-seal` does with `seal-malformed`. A workspace whose approvals use another file name, which these two checks passed before, now fails until the files are renamed.
